name: Pitel
slug: Pitel is an Arch realm at the core of Atlas's rings, known for its unusual relationship to time and its keystone Gatekeeper.
description: Pitel is one of the Arch realms of Atlas, described as the center or core of Atlas’s rings. It has an unusual relationship to time and was previously sought by Dana as a way to reach or access it. Pitel is associated with a keystone, which Dana receives and becomes the Gatekeeper of.

log.summary: Pitel was identified as the center or core of the rings of Atlas and was highlighted for its unusual relationship to time. Dana, who had previously been seeking a way to reach Pitel, was assigned its keystone and became Pitel’s Gatekeeper.
notes: Pitel is described as the center or core of the rings of Atlas.
Dana had previously sought a way to reach Pitel, apparently because of its unusual relationship to time.
Dana receives the Pitel keystone and becomes its Gatekeeper.
